description: This file contains tests for the model-pricing-cache module, verifying functions related to collection, refresh, and retrieval of model pricing data within the openclaw project.

methods.name: __resetGatewayModelPricingCacheForTest
methods.description: Resets the internal model pricing cache for testing purposes.

methods.name: collectConfiguredModelPricingRefs
methods.description: Collects references to models configured across various parts of the system from the given configuration object.

methods.name: getCachedGatewayModelPricing
methods.description: Retrieves cached pricing data for a specific provider and model.

methods.name: refreshGatewayModelPricingCache
methods.description: Fetches current model pricing data from external sources and updates the cache.

methods.name: modelKey

methods.name: withFetchPreconnect
